resources.string:
During a session, ZenLock uses Android’s Accessibility Service to detect which app and screen is open, and app interaction events such as taps. This lets ZenLock show the lock screen when you open a blocked app and keep allowed apps available.

App-access statistics are stored on your device for Insights. ZenLock does not read message contents or typed text, or send this accessibility data to its servers.

Do you agree to this use?
Turn on ZenLock in the list
Choose up to 8 additional apps to use during focus sessions.
Choose a later time for a one-time schedule.
Start five-second unlock wait. Activate again to cancel.
Not available in the Play Store build due to Google\'s SMS policy. Get the APK from GitHub.
